description: Create a publicly discoverable room with a unique @handle. Counts toward the free-plan five-room cap.

description.description: Short room description shown in public discovery.

handle.description: Globally unique @handle (vanity URL): lowercase letters, digits, underscores.

icon.description: A v3 room-icon catalog id, e.g. "bell". Call list_room_icons to discover the valid ids.

location_latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Send all three location fields or none.

location_longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Send all three location fields or none.

location_name.description: Place name shown in nearby discovery. Send all three location fields or none.

show_owner.description: Whether the owner is shown publicly. Defaults to true.

name: create_public_room

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Create Public Room
